Description: Participants listened to an audio containing alternating instructions: 'Imagine the sun on your face' and 'Relax', repeated over 30 cycles.
Instructions: Close your eyes, remain still, and follow each instruction mentally: vividly imagine the sun on your face, then relax during the following segment.
StimulusDescription: The audio consists of 30 alternating cycles of two verbal instructions: one encouraging vivid visual imagery ('Imagine the sun on your face') and one prompting relaxation ('Relax'). Each instruction is followed by a silent pause before the next begins.
CognitiveDescription: Alternating visual imagery and relaxation prompted by verbal instructions.
CognitiveBehavioralInstructions: Stay physically still with eyes closed, imagine sunlight on the face during the imagery instruction, and release mental activity during the relaxation period.
